title: Spectral Tint Blend and Tokenized Interaction Scale for Charts & Controls
creator: Maya Kline
description: Problem: Chart palettes and component tints currently degrade when interpolated across light/dark surfaces; border and micro-shadow tokens are inconsistent for compact controls which causes perceived jitter in dense tables. Goal: introduce a spectral-aware tint blending algorithm and a small set of new semantic tokens (Tint.* and MicroRadius.*) that produce perceptually uniform steps across color ramps and responsive radii for compact components. Deliverables: token spec (JSON + migration guide), updated Figma components, component PRs for Button/Table/Chart tokens, cross-theme QA matrix, and a lightweight migration script for consumers. Non-goal: changing visual language or color semantics for product teams — we aim to preserve existing brand anchors while improving interpolation behavior and small-radius consistency.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Token JSON includes Tint.0..Tint.8 for primary/neutral/critical palettes with documented interpolation method (LAB-based + chroma clamp).
A2: MicroRadius.* tokens defined for compact/regular/expanded with pixel and token fallback values and validated in Figma components.
A3: Charts using the new Tint tokens show no more than 3% perceptual delta (Delta E 2000) across light/dark theme transitions for anchor colors in our test set.
A4: A migration guide and deprecation map published linking old tokens to new semantic salts; at least 3 internal components updated and merged (Button, Table row, SmallChip).
A5: QA checklist completed: contrast checks for 4 AA text sizes, shadow stacking review for 2 elevation levels, visual snapshot baselines in Percy for desktop and compact mobile widths.
design_notes: 2025-02-18 — Kickoff: aligned with Product on preserving brand hue anchors; prioritized charts and compact controls for Q2 rollout.
2025-02-25 — Prototype: created Figma 'Tint Blend' palette frame showing LAB interpolation vs linear RGB; LAB preserved perceived lightness across stops.
2025-03-03 — Trade-offs: LAB interpolation can oversaturate high-chroma anchors on small chips; introduced 'chroma clamp' step to cap chroma at token generation time.
2025-03-07 — Accessibility pass: adjusted Tint.2 and Tint.6 to meet AA for body text on both light and dark surfaces where applicable.
2025-03-10 — Implementation plan: token JSON schema v2 published; migration script prototype (scripts/token-migrate-2.sh) and a draft PR opened for Button component.
